supersedes: wp1b_frozen_agent_protocol_v2 (v2 preserved as history). v3 = v2 + G11 tool-budget + G12 context hygiene.
execution_authorization: WP-1b Calibration-3c authorized (D2 YES, ceiling $0.25, not scored). MAIN_297 + variance + scoring NOT authorized (D3 MANUAL = stop after 3c).

initial_system_prompt.task_intent_placement: RequirementChange.before / .after and acceptance_criteria; the WP-1b per-task intent MUST be the byte-identical stored SIP intent (see wp1a_intent_parity.json).

revision_prompt.note: NOT part of the selection-only arm. G12 is applied to the selection loop ONLY (analyze_impact); revise_plan is untouched (it is dead code for WP-1b).

g11_tool_budget.decision: search_text does NOT consume the 30-distinct-file read budget; read_file keeps MAX_DISTINCT_FILES = 30. Gate v2 CG-10/CG-11 added. This restores the v1.1 behavior the agent actually had.

g12_context_hygiene.nature: Prospective, label-blind agent-scaffold amendment. NOT behavior-preserving: it deliberately removes deterministic context-loop artifacts before the baseline is evaluated. It strengthens the competitor (conservative for the non-inferiority claim).

changes.name: action echo
changes.format: [call {k}/8] you requested: {action} path="{path}" query="{query}" (empty fields omitted)
changes.placement: prepended to every tool result in the selection loop

changes.name: call counter
changes.format: [control] Call {k} of 8. Calls left before the forced final: {8-k}.
changes.placement: appended before every non-final call (calls 1..7). Early action=final availability is ALREADY visible to the model in the frozen schema (TOOL_SCHEMA item 4, AGENT_ACTION_SCHEMA enum, INITIAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT reserved-call-8 note), so it is NOT repeated here (Ahmed's clarification 2026-09-22).

changes.name: named rejection
changes.format: [control warning] Rejected: identical to your previous request ({action} path="{path}" query="{query}"). Its result is shown above. Choose a different action or return action=final.
changes.placement: replaces the fixed 'Repeated identical tool request rejected' sentence. The rejection rule itself is unchanged.

changes.name: truncation note
changes.format: [note] Output truncated: showing the first 2000 of {N} characters. Re-reading the same path returns the same text.
changes.placement: appended when a tool output exceeds the 2000-char observation window

g12_context_hygiene.budget_effect: The echo and counter add about 30-50 prompt tokens per call (measured: the counter is ~15 tokens, the echo ~20-40). Budget-v2 worst cases (base_prompt_tokens + per-call growth x 8) still bound the cost: worst-case prompt tokens per task already assume 8 calls and include the ~810-path editable list; the additive overhead is < 0.05% of the worst-case prompt-token budget, so budget-v2 ceilings are unchanged and still bind. No ceiling change.

sections.parent_repository_snapshot_source: Active snapshot / workspace root at the task's PARENT commit (WP-0 repository-derived ArtifactUniverse; NOT expected_affected_artifacts).
sections.candidate_universe_boundary: ArtifactUniverse derived from the parent repository state via resolve_allowed_artifacts (runner._build_artifact_universe). selected_paths MUST be a non-empty subset of editable paths.

file_read_policy.MAX_FILE_SIZE: 200 KB (files larger are rejected, not truncated)

sections.context_retention_policy: Accumulated tool results are appended to the live prompt; tool output truncated to 2000 chars per result; validation feedback compacted (head 700 / tail 1800). G12 adds the action echo and the truncation note to the appended result text.
sections.context_truncation_policy: finish_reason=length -> control response truncated at cap; loop breaks; if no paths selected -> EMPTY prediction (fail-closed).
sections.round_definition: One round = one model call that may be followed by at most one tool invocation (list_files/read_file/search_text) OR the final decision. Repeated identical tool request is rejected (named control warning).

proposed_hard_max_rounds.note: calls 1..7 explore, call 8 is the reserved final call (force_final).

sections.stop_rule: agent returns action=final with a valid non-empty, unique, editable-subset selected_paths -> accept and stop. Otherwise continue while remaining calls > 0.
sections.timeout_rule: cooperative workflow deadline (ModelCallBudgetExhaustedError) checked before/after each model call -> break; fail-closed EMPTY if no paths selected.
sections.retry_rule: TRANSPORT errors may be retried with a byte-identical request, max 3 retries (SIP precedent); ONLY transport failures may be retried. No content/schema retry.
sections.malformed_output_rule: invalid JSON -> append '[error] Invalid JSON response' and continue if calls remain; otherwise break with EMPTY prediction.
sections.empty_output_rule: empty selected_paths / missing selected_paths -> error message appended; if calls remain continue; else EMPTY prediction.
sections.path_outside_universe_handling: any selected path outside the editable universe -> error list appended; continue if calls remain; else EMPTY prediction. Tools reject traversal/absolute/backslash paths.
sections.duplicate_path_normalization: duplicate selected paths rejected (must be unique); paths are compared exactly against the editable universe (no fuzzy match).
sections.runrecord_audit_field: RunRecord.allow_ground_truth_universe must be persisted and False for every WP-1b agent RunRecord; verified by the WP-1b independent-audit pack (future external audit).
sections.final_file_set_json_schema: AGENT_FINAL_SCHEMA: {action: 'final', selected_paths: [str, ...], rationale: str, requires_iteration: bool} - selected_paths is the predicted file set for the arm.
sections.fail_closed_semantics: no-paths / truncated / exhausted-calls / deadline / malformed -> EMPTY prediction in the primary fail-closed analysis with a separate failure flag.
sections.labels_never_accessed: The prediction pipeline (agent + candidate universe) MUST NOT access label/outcome columns, hidden proxy, target diff, expected affected artifacts, or target outcomes (AC-1A.2).

gate_v3.cg12: no task has >= 3 consecutive rejected repeated requests (deterministic context-loop gate). Expected FAIL on Calibration-3b (runs 1/6/4; RED proof), then must PASS on Calibration-3c.
clean_criteria_cal3c: at least 2 of 3 tasks have >= 1 successful read_file
no run of >= 3 consecutive identical rejected requests
cost ratio to the budget-v2 worst case <= 1.0 on every task
